title: tls: cert_not_after returns String error not typed error
description: crates/tls/src/lib.rs cert_not_after() returns Result<i64, String> while all other functions in the same file return Result<_, TlsError>. An ad-hoc String error type cannot be matched by callers, loses source() chaining, and is inconsistent with the rest of the module's error handling. Should return Result<i64, TlsError> using an appropriate TlsError::CertLoad variant.
